Editorial starting points, not a ranking.

  • GTO Wizard Study Mode documentation

    GTO Wizard · Free · Documentation

    Learn how the study interface specifies a spot and displays its solution.

    Before you use it: Documentation is free to read; software access is separate.

    Public page read · 2026-10-07 · Full listing

  • PioSOLVER Quick Start documentation

    PioSoft · Free · Documentation

    Official documentation introduces the solver interface, building a game tree and browsing a study calculation.

    Before you use it: Reading the manual is free; software licensing is separate. No binary, installation advice or calculation was tested.

    Public page read · 2026-10-07 · Full listing

  • MIT: How to Win at Texas Hold'em Poker (2016)

    MIT OpenCourseWare · Free · Open course

    A distinct hold'em course with video lectures, slides, problem sets, and supporting study materials.

    Before you use it: The title is the course title, not this directory's promise. Historical instruction; catalogue inspected, not all videos watched.

    Public page read · 2026-10-07 · Full listing
